t2.title: People be required to do unpaid community service
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Should people be required to do unpaid community service?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
Community service plays an important role in society. While I support volunteering, I believe making it mandatory is problematic.

Firstly, forcing people to volunteer contradicts the spirit of voluntary work. True community service comes from genuine desire to help others, not legal obligation. Compulsory service may breed resentment rather than civic responsibility.

Secondly, mandatory unpaid work raises ethical concerns. People already pay taxes to fund public services. Requiring additional unpaid labor is unfair, especially for those working multiple jobs or caring for families.

However, supporters argue community service builds social cohesion and teaches valuable skills. For students, it can provide learning experiences outside the classroom. These benefits can be achieved through incentive programs rather than mandates.

Furthermore, governments should focus on removing barriers to volunteering – such as providing transportation and flexible opportunities – rather than forcing participation.

In conclusion, while community service is valuable, it should remain voluntary. Encouragement and support are more effective than compulsion.

t2.sampleB1:
Dear FreshFold Team,

Thank you for your email. I was generally happy with your service. The clothes were clean and folded nicely. The app was convenient for scheduling the pickup and delivery.

However, I think there are some things you could improve. For example, it would be good if you offered different types of detergents, especially for sensitive skin. Also, I would like it if you could send a reminder before the pickup, because I almost forgot to leave the laundry outside.

In terms of additional services, I would be interested in dry cleaning and maybe also shoe cleaning. Thank you for your attention.

Sincerely,
t2.sampleB2: Hi everyone, This is a really interesting question, and I'd love to hear what you all think! Personally, I'm not convinced that forcing people into community service is the right way to go. The whole point of volunteering is that it comes from the heart. The moment you make it compulsory, people tend to do the bare minimum, and it ends up feeling like a chore rather than something meaningful. On the other hand, I can see where the supporters are coming from. Community service can bring people together and teach young people valuable skills they'd never pick up in a classroom. For some, it's a real eye-opener that sparks a lifelong habit of helping out. Still, I reckon there are better ways to get people involved. Instead of twisting people's arms, governments could offer incentives, cut out the red tape, and make volunteering easier to fit around busy lives. At the end of the day, generosity can't be forced. Encourage people, don't push them, and I think you'll see far better results. What do you all think? Have any of you ever been made to volunteer? Dilshod Rahimov
t2.uzSample:
Jamiyat uchun bepul xizmat ko'rsatish muhim rol o'ynaydi. Men ko'ngillilikni qo'llab-quvvatlasam-da, uni majburiy qilish muammoli deb hisoblayman.

Birinchidan, odamlarni ko'ngillilikka majburlash ko'ngillilik ruhiga zid keladi. Haqiqiy jamiyat uchun xizmat qilish boshqalarga yordam berish istagidan kelib chiqadi, qonuniy majburiyatdan emas. Majburiy xizmat fuqarolik mas'uliyatidan ko'ra norozilikni keltirib chiqarishi mumkin.

Ikkinchidan, majburiy bepul ish axloqiy muammolarni keltirib chiqaradi. Odamlar allaqachon davlat xizmatlarini moliyalashtirish uchun soliq to'laydilar. Qo'shimcha bepul mehnatni talab qilish adolatsizlikdir, ayniqsa bir nechta ishlarda ishlaydigan yoki oilalariga g'amxo'rlik qiladiganlar uchun.

Biroq, tarafdorlar jamiyat uchun xizmat qilish ijtimoiy birdamlikni mustahkamlashini va qimmatli ko'nikmalarni o'rgatishini ta'kidlaydilar. Talabalar uchun bu sinfdan tashqari ta'lim olish imkoniyatini yaratishi mumkin. Ushbu afzalliklarga majburiyatlar orqali emas, balki rag'batlantirish dasturlari orqali erishish mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, hukumatlar ishtirok etishga majburlashdan ko'ra, ko'ngillilik uchun to'siqlarni olib tashlashga e'tibor qaratishlari kerak - masalan, transport va moslashuvchan imkoniyatlarni ta'minlash.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, jamiyat uchun xizmat qilish qimmatli bo'lsa-da, u ixtiyoriy bo'lib qolishi kerak. Rag'batlantirish va qo'llab-quvvatlash majburlashdan ko'ra samaraliroqdir.

Shuningdek, agar siz kir yuvishni tashqariga qoldirishni deyarli unutib qo'yganim sababli, olishdan oldin eslatma yuborsangiz, men xursand bo'lardim.

t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli FreshFold jamoasi,

Menga javob xati yuborganingiz uchun rahmat. Umuman olganda, kir yuvish xizmatidan qoniqdim. Tozalash sifati maqtovga loyiq va qulay ilova tufayli olib ketish/yetkazib berish jarayoni muammosiz kechdi. Biroq, menimcha, yaxshilanishi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta sohalar mavjud.

Birinchidan, detarjan tanlash uchun yanada batafsil variantlarni taqdim etish foydali bo'ladi. Ehtimol, ekologik toza yoki allergiyaga qarshi muqobillarni taklif qilish kengroq mijozlar bazasini qamrab olishi mumkin. Ikkinchidan, aloqa yetarli bo'lsa-da, olib ketish va yetkazib berishdan oldin SMS orqali eslatmalar kabi yanada faol bildirishnoma tizimi mijozlar tajribasini yaxshilaydi.

Qo'shimcha xizmatlarga kelsak, men, albatta, quruq tozalashni, ayniqsa, nozik buyumlar uchun qo'shilishini xohlardim. Bundan tashqari, tugmalarni almashtirish yoki tikuvlarni ta'mirlash kabi mayda kiyim-kechaklarni ta'mirlash xizmatlarini taklif qilish FreshFoldni raqobatchilardan ajratib turishi va qo'shimcha qiymat berishi mumkin.

Fikrlarimni ko'rib chiqqaningiz uchun rahmat.

Hurmat bilan,

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the laundry service. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear FreshFold Team, Thank you for asking about my experience with your laundry service. I am extremely satisfied with the quality of your service. My clothes were returned perfectly clean and neatly folded. The pickup and delivery were always punctual, and the app made scheduling incredibly easy. However, I have some suggestions. The turnaround time of 48 hours is sometimes too long for urgent needs. I would appreciate an express service option for same-day or next-day delivery. Additionally, one of my shirts had a small stain that wasn't completely removed. A quality check notification alerting customers about difficult stains would be helpful. I would also love eco-friendly detergent options. Overall, FreshFold has made my life significantly easier. Yours sincerely, Nigora Umarova
t12.sampleA1:
Hi FreshFold!

Clothes good. Clean! App okay. I like fast. Bye!
t12.sampleA2:
Hello FreshFold,

Thank you for the laundry. It was good and clean. The app is easy, but sometimes I need it faster. Can you do faster laundry? And maybe fix the app a little. Thanks!

Bye,

Nigora Umarova
t12.sampleB1:
Dear FreshFold Team,

Thank you for your email. I wanted to tell you about my experience with your laundry service. I think it's pretty good. The clothes were clean, and the delivery was on time, which is important. The app is also easy to use, so that's good too.

However, I think you could improve a few things. For example, sometimes I need my laundry back faster. Maybe you could offer a quicker service? Also, it would be nice if you had different options for detergent, maybe for sensitive skin. Overall, I'm happy, but these changes would make it better.

Sincerely,
Nigora Umarova
t12.sampleB2: Dear FreshFold Team, Thank you for getting in touch to ask about my experience with your laundry service. On the whole, I have been thoroughly impressed. My clothes came back spotless and neatly folded, and the pickup and delivery ran like clockwork. Booking through the app was refreshingly straightforward, which made the whole process hassle-free. That said, I do have a couple of suggestions. Firstly, the standard turnaround time can feel a little long when I need items in a hurry, so an express service option would be greatly appreciated. Secondly, I would welcome a wider range of eco-friendly detergents for customers with sensitive skin. All in all, FreshFold has made my weekly routine far more manageable, and I look forward to seeing the service go from strength to strength. Yours sincerely, Bekzod Aliyev
